column1: Butter or foil-line two 9-inch square pans.
Put the chocolate chips, German chocolate, marshmallow creme, and nuts in a large mixing bowl.
In a 4-quart saucepan, stir the sugar, salt, butter, and evaporated milk over low heat until the sugar fully dissolves.
Bring to a boil and cook 6 minutes.
Pour the hot syrup over the chocolate mixture and beat until all the chocolate melts.
Spread into the prepared pans and let cool 3–5 hours before cutting.
